per_turn.prompt: Read design/data-model.md and design/data-dictionary.md in this repo, then create db/migrations/001_init.sql implementing that schema exactly for PostgreSQL. It must include the btree_gist extension, the six tables, and the exclusion constraint that prevents double-booking a bay for overlapping windows. Do not invent columns that are not in those documents.
Check every monetary column you just wrote. Confirm they are integer paise and named with a _paise suffix, per design/adr/ADR-003-money-as-integer-paise-server-computed.md. Fix any that are not.
Create db/migrations/002_indexes.sql with the indexes listed in the "Keys and indexes" table of design/data-model.md. Do not duplicate the index the exclusion constraint already creates.

Create db/seed.sql that inserts the seven areas from design/data-dictionary.md with plausible Hyderabad coordinates, then about twenty fictional spots spread across those areas, each with between two and eight bays. Every spot name must be invented — no real business may be named. Prices between 2000 and 6000 paise per hour.
Add a single CHECK constraint to the bookings table ensuring amount_paise is never negative. Change nothing else.
Now scaffold a Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript in this repository root, using the app directory. Use the pg library for Postgres, no ORM, per design/stack.md. Do not add any UI yet.
Create lib/db.ts exporting a pooled pg client that reads DATABASE_URL from the environment and never logs the connection string.

Create lib/money.ts with two functions: paiseToDisplay(paise) returning a string like "₹80" with no decimals when paise are a whole rupee, and billableHours(startIso, endIso) returning whole hours rounded up. Include the rounding rule from ADR-003 as a comment.
Write tests for lib/money.ts covering: a whole-rupee amount, an amount with paise, a 90 minute window billing 2 hours, and a 60 minute window billing 1 hour.

Using the availability rule we established earlier from the data model, write lib/availability.ts exporting a function that returns spots in an area having at least one bay with no overlapping non-cancelled booking for a given window. Use a single SQL query.
Create app/api/areas/route.ts implementing GET /api/areas exactly as specified in design/openapi.yaml.
Create app/api/availability/route.ts implementing GET /api/availability exactly as specified in design/openapi.yaml, including the 400 response for bad parameters.
